title: PRII federation doctor-checks manifest
description: Declares the diagnostics/health checks a doctor tool should run for one federation producer repo. Each check is explicitly classed by how authoritatively it can be verified locally (see DiagnosabilityClass in prii_doctor.types) -- the schema does not stop a manifest author from misclassifying a check, but the runners in prii_doctor.runners hardcode their own class regardless of what is declared here, so a mismatch can never produce a false PASS at runtime.

validation_entrypoint.description: Key into this repo's federation.json:hub_callable_commands identifying its own validation-suite command (e.g. 'validation_gates' for aguayluz-pr, 'strict_preflight' for moneysweep-pr). Used by delegate_subprocess checks that omit an explicit check.entrypoint_key.

id.description: Stable, unique, snake_case identifier -- shown as the check's label in both the CLI table and the desktop diagnostics list.

severity_if_absent.description: Only meaningful for presence-only/file_presence checks: whether an absent env var or file renders FAIL (blocking) or WARN (advisory).

operator_action.description: What a human should do about this check -- shown in both the CLI and the GUI regardless of outcome.

manifest_cross_check.description: Documents which existing federation.json field this entry was derived from, e.g. 'federation.json:waf_blocked_sources[0]'. Informational only; not read by the engine.

last_known_state.description: Required in spirit (though not schema-enforced) for not-automatable checks -- the recorded state a human last confirmed, since no automated check can refresh it.

as_of.description: ISO date the state was last confirmed.

check.description: Runner-specific parameters; shape depends on 'type'. See prii_doctor.runners.RUNNERS for the dispatch table.
